title: Roguelike Celebration 2020 Preview
description:
On August 30, 2020, we hosted a preview event for virtual Roguelike Celebration! Seven speakers gave short previews of their talks and a game of 'Help Me Steal the Mona Lisa' was played.

MC: Alexei Pepers twitter.com/ampepers
Speakers: Darren Grey, Julian Day, Todd Furmanski, Tabitha Sable, Gabriel Koenig, Cat Manning, Kate Compton
Details: https://roguelike.club/event2020preview.html

Game by The Delve Bros

Thank you to White Coat Captioning for transcriptions!
